raw.cause: While handling nav's MSG_POSITION request (63860/63870), gps_handle() calls MsgSend() back to nav for a MSG_HINT (63971) before replying. nav's only thread is REPLY-blocked in its own MsgSend() to gps, so it can never MsgReceive() the hint; gps stays SEND-blocked on nav and nav stays REPLY-blocked on gps forever. display, waiting on nav (63840), freezes behind the loop. gps -> nav is also not an allowed edge in blueprint.yaml.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in gps (gps_handle sends MSG_HINT to nav before MsgReply to nav)
raw.fix_summary: Remove the gps -> nav call. A server must not send to its own client. The contract only allows nav -> gps, so gps must answer MSG_POSITION from its own state. If gps really needs route context, nav should put it in the MSG_POSITION request, or gps should get it later through a non-blocking pulse, never a MsgSend back up the chain.
